text:
Eli (CSM): kicking off CloudPort onboarding — hi team 👋 quick sync on stakeholders, success criteria, and timeline. Jordan from CloudPort will chime in with internal owners.
Jordan (CloudPort): hey all — excited. internal owners: me (product), Priya (infra), Sam (security). target go-live: 6/30.
Anya (SE): noted. can we confirm SSO & VPC requirements? CloudPort mentioned SAML and an allowlist for egress.
Jordan (CloudPort): correct — SAML Okta. VPC peering preferred, otherwise IP allowlist. Sam (security) will share the SSO metadata.
Eli (CSM): success criteria draft: 1) test traffic hitting Redwood hosted API with 99th pct latency <250ms; 2) automated alerts for error rate >1%; 3) first 100k tokens/month validated with consented data; 4) enable role-based access in Console for CloudPort admins. Thoughts?
Laura (PM): looks good. add 'runbook handoff' and '2 enablement sessions with dev team' as criteria — important for adoption.
Ravi (Eng): for latency target, what's the expected request size / prompt patterns? need that to size Dedicated or Hosted config.
Jordan (CloudPort): primary flow is short prompts (avg 120 tokens) but occasional long context up to 2k. we'll share a sample traffic CSV.
Anya (SE): for SAML quick checklist: send IdP metadata, assertion consumer URL, attribute mappings (email, groups). sample ACS: https://console.redwood.ai/saml/acs.
Jordan (CloudPort): Sam will drop metadata by EOD tomorrow.
Eli (CSM): timeline proposal: week 1 (this week) — infra owners exchange network & SSO; week 2 — SEs run smoke tests + sample traffic; week 3 — enablement + runbook review; week 4 — pilot with 1 internal app; week 6 — go/no-go for GA.
Laura (PM): can we compress if everything goes green? maybe 3-week fast path for pilot-ready. add decision gate on smoke test pass/fail.
Eli (CSM): noted. I'll track decision gates in the onboarding doc and own runway items. Jordan, can you confirm internal stakeholders and preferred weekly sync cadence?
Jordan (CloudPort): weekly 30m on Tuesdays 10am PT works. stakeholders confirmed.
Anya (SE): I'll create an onboarding checklist in the shared drive and invite Priya + Sam.
OnboardBot: Reminder: please upload test prompt deck to /shared/onboards/CloudPort by 2025-05-09.
Eli (CSM): risks/renewal signals to watch: if pilot doesn't show clear 20% latency improvement vs self-host baseline or if security sign-off delays >2 weeks, flag M1 renewal risk and escalate.
Laura (PM): capture those as 'renewal watch' items in the doc. also solicit initial feedback after enablement session — quick 4-question survey.
Jordan (CloudPort): will do. Priya requested an architecture diagram for network path; Ravi, can your team draft one?
Ravi (Eng): yes, will draft and share by Fri.
Eli (CSM): perfect. next steps: 1) Sam uploads SAML metadata (by EOD tomorrow) 2) Ravi shares arch diagram (Fri) 3) Anya runs smoke tests (wk2) 4) Laura schedules enablement sessions (wk3) — I'll send calendar invites for Tuesday 10am PT weekly.
Jordan (CloudPort): thanks everyone. excited to get started.
Eli (CSM): closing loop — I'll update thread when invites + doc links are posted. :thumbsup:
